what_this_is: The outcome gate of ADR-0085, widened to the paths that actually get heavy by ADR-0087: what importing each of the runtime's real import chains in a pristine child process loads, and what it costs in resident memory. Read by tests/test_runtime_footprint.py. Regenerate, do not hand-edit.

budget_rule.basis: Calibrated on the entry_point path, the lightest one and the only one numpy is absent from: putting numpy on it takes the working set to 66.95 MiB, 3.95 MiB over that path's budget of 63.00 MiB. numpy is the lightest heavy native dependency this project installs at all, so it is the hardest realistic case. One calibration speaks for every path because every budget is `worst observed run + 4.0 MiB` rounded up: what a budget catches is that headroom, which is the same everywhere, not the level the budget sits at. If this margin ever reads UNDER, the headroom has stopped guarding anything and must be tightened; tests/test_runtime_footprint.py fails on a record that says so.

entry_point.covers: What `python -m vspeech` loads before it has read a config file: click, the config schema, the logger, telemetry, preflight, the shared context and the two infrastructure workers (sender/receiver) with their gRPC transport. Every pipeline pays this whichever workers it enables.

module_count.basis: len(sys.modules) after importing vspeech.main. N=10 consecutive runs: min 716, max 716 (spread 0). Budget = max + 16. ADR-0085 requires this indicator to catch pydantic_settings, measured at +31 modules on the entry point (N=10), so the slack is held below that signal -- slightly over half of it, not under -- while still absorbing the submodule shuffle of a routine dependency upgrade.

resident_memory_mib.basis: Working set (GetProcessMemoryInfo) of the child itself after importing vspeech.main. N=10 consecutive runs: min 58.60, median 58.82, max 58.96 MiB -- spread 0.36 MiB (0.6% of the median). Budget = max + 4.0 MiB headroom rounded up, i.e. 4.04 MiB of headroom, about 11x the observed spread, so it does not flap. What this indicator deliberately does not catch is pydantic_settings' ~1.5 MiB of cost unique to the entry point (N=10; ADR-0085) -- the module indicators cover that, which is why there are two.

transcription.covers: The transcription worker as it actually runs, deferred imports included: `av` (pcm_to_waveform), `faster_whisper` (get_transcriber) and `onnxruntime` (the VAD gate, ADR-0037). This is the heaviest path in the project and the one the entry-point measurement could not see -- faster_whisper imports ctranslate2, whose own `try: import torch` loads a merely installed torch, so ADR-0080's 477MB comes back here first and nowhere else.

subtitle_obs.covers: The subtitle worker's OBS back end, which ADR-0040 split out so an OBS pipeline runs headless. **This path is what holds ADR-0040's boundary.** Its imports go through the dispatcher rather than around it, and its recorded module set contains no GUI toolkit, so a toolkit pulled in through the dispatcher -- the exact ADR-0040 regression -- arrives here as an unlisted top-level name and is named by the failure. `tests/test_subtitle_dispatch.py` used to assert that by naming tkinter; ADR-0087 removed the assertion as redundant to this measurement, so this is where the guarantee lives now. Measuring it apart from the TK back end is what keeps the two distinguishable.

stream_vc_consumer.covers: The streaming-VC consumer role (ADR-0055). The whole point of the role split is that a playback-only host stays light: it receives converted audio over UDP and plays it, and must never carry the conversion stack's weight. This path used to be asserted torch-free by name; ADR-0087 keeps the invariant and measures its cost instead.

device_layer.covers: Resolving a GPU and opening an ONNX session (ADR-0078/0024). Deciding which device to use must not drag an inference framework in for one integer: while this layer spoke `torch.device`, the whisper pipeline paid 477MB of RSS and 3.2s of startup for it. This path used to be asserted torch-free by name; ADR-0087 keeps the invariant and measures its cost instead.
